# Albany Airport Taxi and Limo Service (operating as US Limo and Taxi)

> 24/7 taxi, car, and limo service to and from Albany International Airport
> (ALB), JFK, LaGuardia (LGA), Newark (EWR), Boston Logan, and New York City.
> Also provides long-distance trips, courier delivery, non-emergency medical
> transportation, wedding guest shuttles, corporate transportation, Airbnb
> and vacation rental transportation, and transportation to recovery and
> treatment programs — across the Capital Region, Hudson Valley,
> Adirondacks, and Berkshires.

- Phone: (518) 327-0700
- Email: info@albanyairport.taxi
- Address: 1410 Curry Road, Rotterdam, NY 12306
- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
- Service area: 23 counties across New York, Vermont, and Massachusetts —
  Albany, Rensselaer, Saratoga, Schenectady, Columbia, Greene, Dutchess,
  Ulster, Delaware, Otsego, Schoharie, Montgomery, Washington, Warren,
  Hamilton, Essex, Franklin, Clinton, Herkimer, and Fulton counties in NY;
  Bennington and Rutland counties in VT; Berkshire county in MA
- Fleet: taxi, sedan, SUV, and limo vehicles
- Differentiators: flat pricing with no surge charges, flight tracking
  included on airport trips, and real phone dispatch that works in rural
  areas where rideshare driver coverage is thin or nonexistent
